title: What to expect at Computex 2026: AI chips, budget PCs competing with the MacBook Neo, Nvidia entering laptop SoC market with the rumored N1X chip, and more (PCMag)
summary: PCMag: What to expect at Computex 2026: AI chips, budget PCs competing with the MacBook Neo, Nvidia entering laptop SoC market with the rumored N1X chip, and more — The theme for Computex 2026, according to organizer TAITRA, is “AI Together.” Sure, it sounds a little like a tech-industry group hug.
